text: I'm a foster carer and I've had this little one, she's 17 months, for a few weeks. Tonight her temperature went up to 39.3 and honestly it frightened the life out of me, I've never seen a number that high on her. I gave her ibuprofen like the leaflet says, and in between doses she's been playing with her stacking cups, drinking her water and babbling away at me like normal, which I keep telling myself is a good sign. But I don't know her history the way a parent would and I'm terrified of getting something wrong with a child who isn't mine. I've been checking on her every ten minutes. I just need someone to tell me what I should be watching for overnight and when I should be worried, because right now my heart is going a mile a minute.
